origin.description: Records skip, comments, and whether blank rows are ignored. The default keeps blank rows.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The data, path, or collector this function accepts.

origin.details: Records skip, comments, and whether blank rows are ignored. The default keeps blank rows.
origin.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
origin.example:
source <- datasource(I("a\n1"), skip = 2, comment = "#")
paste(source$skip, yn(source$skip_empty_rows), source$comment, yn(source$skip_quote), sep = ";")

translation.description: Records skip, comments, and whether blank rows are ignored. The default keeps blank rows.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The data, path, or collector this function accepts.

translation.details: Records skip, comments, and whether blank rows are ignored. The default keeps blank rows.
translation.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
translation.example:
source = datasource(I("a\n1"), skip=2, comment="#")
return str(source["skip"]) + ";" + yn(source["skip_empty_rows"]) + ";" + source["comment"] + ";" + yn(source["skip_quote"])
